The '''Ruur Night Herald''' was a [[Killik/Legends|Killik]] that held the position of [[Night Herald]] among the [[Ruur]] Killik hive on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] during the [[Alderaan Civil War]]. The Killik was [[Death/Legends|slain]] by Republic forces that invaded the [[Ruur Killik Burrows]].
